Amanda — thanks for sending these over and for the call this morning.

Quick checklist we need to complete vendor activation on our side:
1) Legal name + EIN (exact match to W-9) — please confirm.
2) Bank account type (checking/savings), ACH routing + account, and whether you also accept wires (SWIFT/IBAN if outside US).
3) For our ERP mapping: invoice field names we read are "invoice_number", "po_number", "invoice_date", "line_total" and an optional "remit_to" field (up to 64 chars). If you can include a "vendor_code" column we will map it to internal vendor codes — we prefer VELVET-LOG as a short tag but we can accept your choice.
4) We will kick off micro-deposits for ACH verification once bank details are uploaded; that usually completes in 1-2 business days.

Marissa — can you confirm the PO label we discussed (Vendor Code + PO# in header) and whether we need the invoice PDF to include the signed W-9 as a separate file or embedded?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
